title: ITAR personnel-scope determinations need protected evidence references
remediation: The sponsor empowered official, counsel and personnel security owner review whether the provision is relevant to the assessed personnel boundary. Where the organization already relies on a decision, verify signed scope and review records and separately confirm custody of the existing supporting evidence. Keep personal and controlled information restricted. Record unresolved applicability.

milestones.title: Collect a signed applicability or pending decision and a redacted review linking to protected personnel and authority records
